model.name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA PDD 8-Step 33B
model.description: Generates synchronized video and audio from text and reference media. Each PDD step merges four learned denoising-interval outputs, covering 32 intervals in only 8 model evaluations.

prompt:
summary: [reference generation] Place the subject on a deserted midnight railway platform where a paper bird awakens the station clock during one five-second shot.
detailed_description: A steady medium close-up preserves the subject's identity and appearance while a tiny folded paper bird opens its wings, lands on the stopped clock's minute hand, and makes the mechanism advance with one solid click.
overall_soundscape: Night wind, a soft paper-wing flutter, one heavy clockwork click, and a distant rail hum.
